scope: P2, separately attributable from P1. Existing PumpPortalBirthAudit gains explicit compact-only mode; existing raw mode remains separate and disabled by qualified launcher. No new database/table/index/worker.
source_authority: Original PP-supplied fields remain immutable and separate from canonical comparison. Receipt timestamp is local arrival, not chain time. Accepted PP source does not mean independently RPC-decoded CREATE.
identity: SHA256 canonical source/mint/supplied creator/signature; first local receipt timestamp preserved across reconnect/restart. Conflicting supplied fields form distinct evidence, never overwrite the original values.
storage_authority: Explicit dedicated compact path in existing audit component; raw authority cannot be reused. Class-wide lock under single qualified listener process. Four-KiB whitelist files; atomic temp/fsync/rename/directory-fsync. No asynchronous audit worker is started in compact mode.
retention: Finite retained population, no automatic deletion or cleanup. At capacity, new provenance fails visibly to UNKNOWN; ingestion and existing durable birth retries continue under their original contracts. This is not unlimited retention or a guarantee of gap-free telemetry. Later deployment must verify single writer, exact dedicated path, filesystem ownership, capacity and headroom.
failure_contract: Receipt failure cannot claim provenance success. Primary/retry failure remains explicit. Retry reconstructs same receipt from existing compact envelope and updates only after verified Core persistence. Core commit and sidecar commit are not one atomic transaction: interruption may leave UNCONFIRMED/UNKNOWN, never fabricated success.
handoff_marker: Separate typed metadata immediately before existing OPS submit; denotes initiation/ATTEMPTED, not successful OPS commit. First marker immutable across duplicate migrations. Actual delivery/ACK/execution are read from their canonical authorities.
measurement: Complete unique canonical migration cohort required. Count retained structurally valid PP-source receipts with verified Core commit/readback accepted before recorded OPS initiation. RPC recovery is separately qualified and may overlap. Missing receipt means UNKNOWN delivery provenance. Empty/incomplete denominator gives UNKNOWN percentages; over-budget input rejected, never approximated.
rollback: P2 listener/collector/launcher-only rollback; preserve compact sidecars and pending retry/intents. Existing raw mode must remain off. P1 can remain installed independently. No schema or queue rewind.
